Ohio Valley tournament champions |bowl=NCAA Tournament |bowl_result=Round of 64 }} {{2012–13 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2012–13 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team''' represented [[Belmont University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bruins, led by 27th-year head coach [[Rick Byrd]], played their home games at the [[Curb Event Center]] and were first year members of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]] in the East Division. They finished the season 26–7, 14–2 in OVC play to be champions of the West Division. They were also champions of the [[2013 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]], winning the championship game in overtime over Murray State, to earn their third consecutive trip to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Arizona. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2012|team=Belmont Bruins|teamcolors=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Chad|last=Lang|num=0|pos=C|ft=6|in=11|lbs=275|class=SO|rs=yes|home=[[Marietta, Georgia]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Jeff|last=Laidig|num=1|pos=G|ft=6|in=4|lbs=210|class=FR|rs=|home=[[Mishawaka, Indiana]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Blake|last=Jenkins|num=2|pos=F|ft=6|in=7|lbs=210|class=JR|rs=yes|home=[[Knoxville, Tennessee]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Kerron|last=Johnson|link=y|num=3|pos=G|ft=6|in=1|lbs=175|class=SR|rs=|home=[[Huntsville, Alabama]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Holden|last=Mobley|num=4|pos=G|ft=6|in=3|lbs=200|class=SO|rs=yes|home=[[Nashville, Tennessee]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Caleb|last=Chowbay|num=5|pos=G|ft=6|in=2|lbs=170|class=FR|rs=|home=[[Mt.
